name: Survey tile in Aries
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.7 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aries, imaged by SPHEREx 12 times in 3 visits over 16 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 22 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 16 hours starting 2026-01-23, at wavelengths from 0.77 to 4.86 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
